# ContriGraph

> ContriGraph is an intelligent project management platform for student software teams.

## What it does

- Plans projects with roles, milestones, tasks, priorities, deadlines, effort, skills, and dependencies.
- Calculates planned workload from declared weekly availability and remaining task effort.
- Schedules work in half-hour slots across working days, holidays, and per-day overrides.
- Identifies blocked tasks, delivery risk, overloaded members, underused capacity, and single-specialist tasks.
- Combines workload across accessible projects for linked team members.
- Previews safe task redistribution before approval and protects members who are the only qualified person for a task.
- Tracks progress updates, comments, attachments, reviews, approvals, and contribution evidence.

## Public links

- Product: https://dsvv.live/contrigraph/
- Help and product guides: https://dsvv.live/contrigraph/help/
- Sitemap: https://dsvv.live/contrigraph/sitemap.xml
- Source: https://github.com/realcodedbyom/contrigraph

## Interpretation

Workload is a forecast based on declared capacity and remaining effort. It is not automatic time tracking and does not rank people by task count.
